mapper.sql: id, task_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, storage_path, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_attachment (task_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, storage_path, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{storagePath}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.task_id, a.filename, a.content_type, a.size_bytes, a.storage_path, a.created_at FROM task_attachment a JOIN task t ON t.id = a.task_id JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0 AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT FROM task_attachment WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id
